root_cause.guest_path: UIFlow2 camera module (BOARD_ID 144) builds esp32-camera with CONFIG_SCCB_SOFTWARE_SUPPORT and probes GC0308 at 0x21 over a bit-banged SCCB bus on SDA GPIO12 / SCL GPIO9 (m5stack/components/esp32-camera/driver/sccb.c SCCB_Init/SCCB_Probe; m5stack/cmodules/omv/modules/py_camera.c BOARD_ID==144 branch).
root_cause.model_gap: M5.begin() first drives the on-board sensors through the modelled ESP32-S3 hardware I2C controller. esp32s3_soft_i2c_set_hardware_active_on_bus() closed every software-I2C bridge on the shared QEMU I2CBus as a permanent hardware hand-off, including the camera bridge on GPIO12/GPIO9 whose pads the controller never owned. The guest SCCB waveform was still delivered to the bridge and decoded, but dropped after the hardware_active guard.

pre_fix_debug_evidence.note: temporary fprintf diagnostics (removed before the exported patch)

fix: m5stopwatch_soft_i2c_init_dedicated_pins(): bridge variant whose pads are owned only by that bit-banged bus; it ignores the hardware-controller hand-off. Used for the AtomS3R-CAM camera SCCB bridge on GPIO12/GPIO9. Existing boards keep the one-way hand-off.

m5atoms3rcam machine class default_ram_size = 8 MiB: models the ESP32-S3-PICO-1-N8R8 octal PSRAM. esp32-camera allocates frame buffers with MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM; without the PSRAM model camera.init() stops after SCCB probe.
m5_lcd_cam attach geometry for AtomS3R-CAM set to QVGA 320x240 RGB565, matching the camera module's default frame size so the deterministic DVP waveform fills exactly one frame buffer.

No frame bytes, PID or register values are injected from the host Python layer.
